name: std-notification-panel
description: std-notification-panel — the bell's overlay surface. A dedicated modal-only trait that renders the notification list a consumer already passes to std-app-layout's `notifications` knob, and dismisses with a single (render-ui modal null). Mount it beside the app layout and route the layout's notificationClickEvent into OPEN; the catalog trait underneath is never repainted, so opening and closing the bell cannot strand the viewer. Owning the overlay in its own trait is what makes the shape legal — a modal rendered from the trait that also owns `main` is rejected by CIRCUIT_MODAL_EXIT_INCOMPLETE.

closeLabel.description: Label on the button that closes the overlay.
